name: LIFX
description: LIFX Wi-Fi bulbs over the public LIFX LAN protocol (UDP 56700): GetService broadcast discovery, one colour per bulb with SetColor (HSBK), at most 20 messages a second, colour and power restored on shutdown. Multizone strips and tiles get one colour. Untested: nobody working on HueDeck owns a LIFX bulb. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/lifx.md.
